papers.title_en: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yuxiang Lu, Yantong Liu, Jinghua Hou, Xueli Sun, Ruihua Han, Zhe Liu, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向机器人操作策略的具身基础模型蒸馏
papers.tldr: 大规模动作预训练能赋予具身基础模型强操作、泛化与闭环鲁棒性，但复现依赖大量机器人数据和算力。TILDE把学生诱导状态上的在线蒸馏与教师执行恢复轨迹的学习统一起来，并借助AutoDAgger用机器人奖励模型监控进度、触发教师干预，自动收集纠错经验。在三个真实任务上，TILDE最高达到行为克隆的4.1倍性能，恢复轨迹收集速度较人工流程提升2倍以上。该工作无需动作预训练即可迁移EFM能力，并支持跨架构蒸馏。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale action pretraining equips Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) with strong manipulation capabilities, with particular strengths in generalization and closed-loop robustness, but reproducing such pretraining requires substantial robot data and computation. To transfer these capabilities from pretrained EFMs to policies without action pretraining, we introduce TILDE (Teacher-In-the-Loop Distillation from EFMs), which synergizes on-policy distillation at student-induced states with learning from teacher-executed recovery trajectories. We further propose AutoDAgger, an autonomous data aggregation pipeline in which a robotic reward model is utilized to monitor task progress and trigger teacher intervention, thereby collecting recovery experience without human monitoring or manual control. AutoDAgger accelerates recovery-trajectory collection by more than $2\times$ compared with the human-in-the-loop method. By unifying learning from demonstrations, on-policy teacher supervision, and teacher's corrective behavior, TILDE improves task performance by up to $4.1\times$ over behavior cloning across three real-world tasks and supports effective cross-architecture distillation.

papers.title_en: Diverse Schedules for Makespan Minimization on Unrelated Machines
papers.authors: Sebastian Bruchhold, Matthias Mnich, Karolina Tammemaa, Morten Weber, Michalis Xefteris, Bart Zondervan
papers.evidence: 无关并行机上多样化作业调度与最大完工时间最小化
papers.tldr: 研究无关并行机上最小化完工时间并输出多个差异化调度的问题，以加权Hamming距离衡量调度间作业分配差异。针对max-sum目标，作者在多项式时间内同时保持经典2倍完工时间近似与最优多样性。针对max-min目标，证明即使无完工约束、判断三个调度是否存在给定两两多样性也NP难，并设计两类双准则近似算法。该工作为不确定性下的调度选择提供理论保证。
papers.abstract_en: We study makespan minimization on unrelated machines with the additional goal of constructing diverse schedules: Instead of outputting a single schedule, we seek a collection of schedules with provable makespan guarantees and substantially different job assignments. Committing to a single schedule in advance may be undesirable. Processing times may be uncertain, and constraints or domain knowledge may emerge later, so $k$ schedules of similar quality offer meaningful alternatives. We measure pairwise diversity by the weighted Hamming distance between job assignments and study the two standard objectives in the diverse-solutions literature: max-sum diversity, which maximizes the total pairwise distance between schedules, and max-min diversity, which maximizes the smallest pairwise distance.   For the max-sum objective, we show that optimal diversity can be achieved in polynomial time without sacrificing the classic makespan approximation factor. For every feasible makespan target $T$, we can compute $k$ schedules of makespan at most $2T$ whose max-sum diversity is optimal among all $k$ schedules of makespan at most $T$. Therefore, we match the classic factor-$2$ makespan guarantee of Lenstra, Shmoys, and Tardos (Math. Prog., 1990) and preserve optimal diversity.   For the max-min objective, we show that the diversity problem is inherently harder. Namely, we show that, even without makespan constraints, deciding whether three schedules of given pairwise diversity exist is NP-hard. We complete this with two complementary bicriteria approximation algorithms for every fixed $k$ and $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$. The first preserves almost all of the optimal max-min diversity with makespan at most $(3\lceil12/\varepsilon\rceil+1)T$. The second keeps the makespan arbitrarily close to the classic $2$ guarantee while achieving a $\frac{1}{2}(1-\varepsilon)$ fraction of the optimal max-min diversity.

papers.title_en: Workflow-Aware Communication and Computation Scheduling for Mobile Edge AI Agents
papers.authors: Xingqiu He, Chaoqun You, Feng Wang, Zihan Chen, Shuai Wang, Jihong Park
papers.evidence: 面向智能体工作流的计算放置与边缘资源在线调度
papers.tldr: 移动边缘AI智能体执行多步工作流时，后续步骤依赖中间结果，工作流结构在执行中逐步揭示，给在线调度带来不确定性。论文用动态工作流图刻画部分可见流程，将加权完成时延目标转化为每时隙持有成本，并基于Bellman方程与前瞻cost-to-go代理设计在线算法。算法联合决定计算放置，并依据操作关键性分配无线资源块和边缘算力。仿真表明该方案在多种场景下优于基准，为动态工作流边缘AI提供有效调度思路。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly deployed in mobile edge environments to autonomously handle diverse tasks through multi-step workflows. Unlike conventional dependency-aware tasks with predefined dependency structures, agent workflows are dynamically generated based on intermediate execution results. To minimize the weighted sum of job completion latencies, this paper models partially revealed agent workflows using dynamic workflow graphs and formulates an online scheduling problem that jointly optimizes computation placement, wireless resource block allocation, and edge computing resource allocation. To address the uncertainty of future workflow evolution, we first transform the weighted completion time objective into an equivalent per-slot holding cost and characterize the optimal policy through a Bellman equation. We then construct a tractable look-ahead cost-to-go surrogate based on the revealed workflow and the estimated remaining latencies of active jobs. The proposed scheduling algorithm leverages the surrogate to determine computation placement and uses the resulting operation criticality to allocate wireless and edge computing resources online. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the benchmark schemes across diverse scenarios.

papers.title_en: Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm
papers.evidence: 在调度作业的同时学习上下文相关服务速率
papers.tldr: 研究上下文排队bandit中调度作业并学习未知服务率的问题，现有衰减遗憾保证要么衰减率次优，要么依赖已知时域与额外协方差假设。提出WISE算法，以最宽区间选择与消除机制自适应调度，无需已知时域。在容量松弛条件下达到每足够大时刻率最优的O~(t^(-1/2))队列长度遗憾，且不要求协方差下界。还给出更紧的下界并量化容量松弛影响，仿真显示上下文松弛失效时仍保持小遗憾。
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

papers.title_en: Serve Now or Improve Later? Scheduling Self-Evolution in Online Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yangbo Wei, Junhong Qian, Zhen Huang, Zhenyu Su, Qifan Wang, Shaoqiang Lu, Rumin Zhang, Chen Wu, Lei He
papers.evidence: 在线智能体系统中算力分配的状态感知调度器
papers.tldr: 在线 agent 可通过构建工具、指南或模型状态提升未来服务能力，但这会与当前请求争夺同一批 GPU。LearnSched 把能力复用窗口与算力及时回收纳入统一的投资模型，并结合候选进度、检查点开销与当前恢复路径，用单步反事实推演在推进、存档与等待之间做出选择。在 1920 组配对有限模型场景中，当冷恢复代价高昂时，延长执行窗口、减少交接反而提升净价值；在热恢复场景中，强窗口策略已取得同等价值。这表明保留可恢复状态可能比复杂的演化调度更关键。
papers.abstract_en: Online agents can improve future service by constructing reusable tools, guidance, or model states, but this work competes with current requests for the same GPUs. Exploiting idle compute for self-evolution faces a fundamental systems constraint: benefits arrive only after an artifact is published and used, while pausing evolution leaves service capacity waiting for memory release and runtime recovery. An investment worth completing may therefore be worth postponing. We present LearnSched, a state-aware scheduler that brings the reuse window of a capability and the timely return of compute into a common investment model. LearnSched incorporates candidate progress, checkpoint overhead, and the current recovery path into action values. Under the same information and capacity constraints, it uses one-step counterfactual rollout to choose progress, checkpointing, or waiting relative to a fully costed window policy. We characterize handoff costs through independent A100 component measurements and evaluate action selection in 1920 paired finite-model scenarios. When cold recovery is expensive, waiting for longer execution windows can improve net value by avoiding handoffs; in evaluated warm-recovery scenarios, the strong window policy already achieves the same value. Retaining recoverable state can shorten capacity return and reduce the need for complex evolution scheduling.

papers.title_en: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Lingsen Zhang, Wei Li, Jie He, Henghua Zhang, Kai Mo, Shiyong Li, Yanpeng Wang, Rui Shao
papers.evidence: 以紧凑状态增量进行未来预测的世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 现有VLA直接学习观测到动作映射，语义理解与执行间存在负担，世界动作模型完整预测未来又浪费于静态外观。VLDA将完整未来预测改写为紧凑可操作迁移建模，用Delta变量作为视觉语言理解与动作生成的接口。方法以LT-Filter和GT-Anchor统一学习Delta，并通过DDAR将其注入动作去噪。实验显示其提升长程一致性、鲁棒性与泛化，验证了可操作Delta替代直接动作预测和完整未来建模的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

papers.title_en: SafeWall: A Risk-Aware Job Walltime Recommendation for HPC Scheduling
papers.authors: Kanglin Xu, Michael Papka, Zhiling Lan
papers.evidence: 面向高性能计算调度的风险感知作业时长推荐
papers.tldr: HPC作业需用户提交walltime，但估计常不准且低估会导致作业被提前终止。SafeWall在预测值上加入非负安全缓冲，并依据用户历史行为动态校准风险边际，数据不足时用统计收缩对齐全局基线。在五个公开负载及Theta全生命周期日志上，它显著降低低估风险并保持有竞争力的准确率。该轻量模块化方法可适配多种学习型预测模型，为HPC调度提供更安全的walltime推荐。
papers.abstract_en: In high-performance computing (HPC), users must submit resource requirements for their jobs, with user-supplied walltime being a critical parameter. However, these estimates are notoriously inaccurate, as users tend to overestimate walltime to prevent the scheduler from terminating their jobs prematurely. While existing work on learning-based walltime prediction primarily focuses on maximizing prediction accuracy, such predictions are inherently risky for walltime recommendations. Specifically, underestimation leads to job termination before completion, resulting in lost progress and wasted resources. In this study, we present SafeWall, a novel recommendation method that adjusts walltime predictions by incorporating an explicit, nonnegative safety buffer to mitigate underestimation risk. The core of our approach is a risk-aware buffer that dynamically calibrates safety margins based on individual user's historical behavior. When user data is limited, the system employs statistical shrinkage to align these margins with a global baseline, ensuring robustness. This yields a lightweight mechanism that optimizes the trade-off between prediction accuracy and termination risk. SafeWall is modular and applicable to various learning-based prediction models. We evaluate SafeWall using five public workload traces, including the full-lifetime job log from the 4,392-node Theta machine at the Argonne Leadership Computing Facility. Across all traces, SafeWall substantially reduces underestimation risk compared to the unbuffered base predictors, while preserving competitive accuracy. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/SPEAR-UIC/JSSPP26-SafeWall.

papers.title_en: Inspect Robots: Evaluating the Capabilities and Safety of Embodied AI
papers.authors: Christopher Leet, Achu Menon, Sravanthi Machcha, Sabrina Zou, Aayushya Patel, Aditya Kumar Singh, Anish Kr Singh, Galaba Vamsi, Javin Ahuja, Sai Asish Yamani, Tushar Anand, Vedang Alle, Zihan Jack Zhang, Tzu Kit Chan, Jay Chooi
papers.evidence: 评估具身人工智能能力与安全性的开源框架
papers.tldr: 通用语言模型正被用于控制机器人硬件，亟需评估其具身能力与安全风险。作者提出 Inspect Robots，一个模块化开源框架，提供可复用物理评估抽象及自动化配置、执行与终止基础设施。用该框架评估了六个基于前沿语言模型的策略，并已在发布三个月内获得近十万次下载。它为具身智能评测与安全研究提供了可扩展工具。
papers.abstract_en: General purpose language models are increasingly able to control robotic hardware. Understanding the capabilities and safety of these models when embodied is therefore increasingly important for understanding their societal impact and risks. To this end, we introduce Inspect Robots, a modular, open-source framework for developing and running evaluations of embodied agents. Inspect Robots pairs customizable, reusable abstractions for specifying physical evaluations and analyzing their results with infrastructure that automates evaluation setup, execution and termination. We demonstrate Inspect Robots by using it to evaluate the capabilities and safety of six policies based on frontier language models. Inspect Robots has seen significant early uptake, receiving nearly 100,000 downloads in the three months since its release.

papers.title_en: Toward Trustworthy Physical AI for Human Interaction
papers.authors: Niccolò Pagliarani, Maximilian Stölzle, Cosima du Pasquier, Jeff Lui, Andrew Sabelhaus, Cecilia Laschi, Gentiane Venture, Daniela Rus, Matteo Cianchetti
papers.evidence: 涵盖具身、控制与认知的可信物理智能框架
papers.tldr: 机器人正加速进入人类空间，但社会尚未建立其可信性标准。作者提出可信物理AI框架，将安全性、行为可理解性与感知对齐贯穿具身、控制、认知和设计四个层面。该框架强调，可信性并非单一指标，而源于物理能力、可观察行为与人际互动期望的持续对齐。这为面向人机交互的可信物理AI提供了整合性概念基础。
papers.abstract_en: Robots are entering human spaces faster than we can establish when they deserve trust. We propose a framework for trustworthy physical AI that integrates Safety, Behavioral Intelligibility, and Perceptual Alignment across embodiment, control, cognition, and design. Trustworthiness emerges from aligning physical capabilities, observable behavior, and expectations people form during interaction.

papers.title_en: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
papers.authors: Zhiqin Yang, Chenxin Li, Xiaomeng Hu, Yibin Liu, Weidong Huang, Jiankai Sun, Haitao Li, Zijian Wu, Yuzhi Huang, Fanding Huang, Hanwen Sun, Jiashun Liu, Jingqi Tong, Mingxin Huang, Shaoli Hu, Shijue Huang, Tianyi Bai, Xinyuan Wang, Yunlong Lin, Zhengyang Tang, Zhexin Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Xierui Song, Juntao Dai, Boyuan Chen, Jiaming Ji, Fangneng Zhan, Mengkang Hu, Wei Xue, Yonggang Zhang, Han Hu, Tsung-Yi Ho, Yike Guo
papers.evidence: 评测多模态智能体执行物理机器人任务的仿真测试平台
papers.tldr: 通用智能体能否将数字工具能力迁移到物理机器人执行尚不明确。作者提出RobotWorld仿真基准，以84项涵盖操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶和空中控制的任务，配合交互预算与可执行成功检查评测机器人使用。实验发现智能体可搭建分割、标定、空间估计与动力学计算流程，却难以稳定组合成成功行为，常在状态跟踪、纠错和完成判定上失败，不同模型优势亦分化。该工作提供严格测试平台并定位物理世界智能体的关键能力缺口。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

papers.title_en: iAm.md: Robot Skill Self-Assessment through Agentic Introspection for Unknown Open-Vocabulary Domains
papers.authors: Vincenzo Guarino, Emanuele Musumeci, Vincenzo Suriani, Daniele Nardi
papers.evidence: 通过智能体内省实现机器人技能自评估与具身规划落地
papers.tldr: 大模型驱动机器人规划时，受上下文窗口与幻觉限制，可能生成环境或机器人本体并不支持的技能，造成grounding failure。iAm.md提出Markdown标准与生成框架，将开放词汇语义地图中的视觉语言检测、目标分割和持久对象记录结合为部署证据，支持智能体内省。在仿真TIAGo的导航与操作任务上，该标准化表示同时支撑技能自评估与可执行任务泛化，为未知开放词汇域提供可验证的技能生成思路。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI based on Large Language Model generalization capabilities offers a wide range of potential applications, including planning for embodied tasks. For example, embodied agents based on Foundation models can generate plausible plans in autonomous robotics scenarios. Due to limited context windows or hallucinatory phenomena in the next-token prediction formulation, behaviors may be generated without establishing whether the deployed robot and the observed environment actually support the requested operation, in what we call a "grounding failure". Thanks to the recent improvements in reasoning capabilities of foundation models, autonomous robot behavior generation problem can be formulated as a code generation problem. We present iAm.md, a Markdown standard and generation framework, that allows anchoring this process in complementary forms of deployment evidence. Through open-vocabulary semantic mapping, we combine local vision-language detections and object segmentation and refer them to persistent object records in this intermediate standardized representation, allowing agentic introspection. We then study this new technique on a simulated TIAGo, on navigation-and-manipulation tasks, showing how this standardized representation jointly supports skill self-assessment and executable task generalization.

papers.title_en: Holistic Buoyancy-Driven Cloud Native Resource Management
papers.authors: Oliver Larsson, Thijs Metsch, Cristian Klein, Erik Elmroth
papers.evidence: 多租户云环境中的自适应工作负载调度与资源管理
papers.tldr: 多租户云环境中，工作负载竞争末级缓存和内存带宽，拥塞随负载组成与需求动态变化，静态资源需求或预先剖析难以适应。本文利用运行时“负载浮力”刻画工作负载对单项资源及端到端性能的敏感度，并将浮力贯穿工作负载调度、节点内资源分配和生命周期内重调度。基于Kubernetes实现原型后，在多节点集群和不同拥塞程度下评估；高拥塞时满足SLO的工作负载比例由7.74%升至87.8%，同时降低资源拥塞、SLO违约严重度和集群碎片。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient resource management is a challenge in multi-tenant cloud environments as workloads compete for shared resources such as last-level cache and memory bandwidth, whose congestion can change dynamically as workload composition and resource demands evolve. Existing resource management approaches often rely on static resource requirements or prior workload profiling, limiting their ability to respond to changing resource contention as required in the cloud. In this paper, we leverage workload buoyancy, a runtime framework for capturing workload sensitivity to individual resources and application-level performance, to enable adaptive scheduling and resource management. We propose a holistic approach that incorporates buoyancy into workload scheduling, node-local resource allocation, and workload rescheduling throughout the workload lifecycle. We implement our approach as a Kubernetes-native prototype and evaluate it on a multi-node cluster using diverse cloud workloads under varying levels of resource contention. In a high-congestion scenario, our approach increases the percentage of workloads satisfying their SLOs from 7.74% to 87.8% on average compared with the Kubernetes baseline, while reducing resource congestion, the severity of SLO violations, and cluster fragmentation using limited rescheduling.

papers.title_en: Budgeted Admission from Timestamped Capacity Records in Shared Clusters
papers.tldr: 共享集群准入常依赖过时容量记录，使准入与不可用联合风险难以控制。本文在固定观测延迟下，对对称 Markov 状态推导稳态准入边界，并用有限似然分配处理带延迟戳的交付记录。方法以单侧精确二项端点校准各策略，并加入确定性预算守卫，受控系统通过独立审计且无事件缺失、身份或状态错配。该工作给出可执行、可审计的预算化准入流程，并验证 Job 与 Pod 的请求核算一致性。
papers.abstract_en: A cluster admission gate can receive a capacity record that no longer matches current schedulability. We study one exogenous binary schedulability unit under a bound on the joint probability of admission and unavailability. For a symmetric Markov state, we derive the stationary admission frontier for a fixed observation delay and apply finite likelihood allocation to a delay-tagged delivered record. A one-sided exact binomial endpoint calibrates each fitted policy, and exact enumeration confirms the per-policy confidence target in every tested parameter cell. A separate deterministic guard charges every unresolved admission against the realized allowance and bounds unavailable-state admissions at every prefix under truthful outcome feedback. An executable admission procedure composes the allocation and guard. The controlled system binds source sampling, NATS delivery, randomized admission, Kubernetes objects, and API-derived outcomes in one append-only record. Independent audit finds no missing event, identity mismatch, or state mismatch in the completed functional block. A separate CPU request-accounting check preserves Job and Pod identity across an unschedulable-to-complete transition.

papers.title_en: SatCraft: Agentic Optimization of Scheduling Policies for Satellite-Cellular Edge Services
papers.authors: Pengcheng Luo, Dengke Deng, Zenghui Zhang, Genke Yang, Jian Chu
papers.evidence: LLM智能体优化边缘服务的联合调度策略
papers.tldr: 卫星—蜂窝边缘服务需在覆盖间歇、链路变化与资源受限下联合调度计算与传输，固定策略难修正调度逻辑缺陷。SatCraft让LLM智能体依据执行反馈改写联合调度策略代码，并做策略检查与完整运行评估。实验基于Starlink与蜂窝实测数据，较ADPRL、EdgeOPT、TF-DDRL等基线提升累计完成服务价值3.61%-16.89%，四类资源配置均最优，平均每次调度25.02 ms。表明LLM引导的策略优化可提升卫星—蜂窝网络中的完整服务交付。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile edge services can combine local computation with satellite and cellular access to deliver time-sensitive results in areas with intermittent terrestrial coverage. Meeting their deadlines and quality requirements calls for joint computation and transmission scheduling that accounts for task dependencies, changing link capacity, and shared resource budgets. However, optimizing resource allocations or tuning parameters within a fixed policy structure offers limited scope to correct failures rooted in the scheduling logic. We propose SatCraft, a framework in which a large language model (LLM) agent uses execution feedback to revise the code of joint scheduling policies. Each revision undergoes policy checks and complete-run evaluation to assess its validity, runtime, and effects on service completion. Because policy performance varies with access conditions, SatCraft retains valid alternatives in a policy library and selects one for each episode using initial access observations and the known resource configuration. Experiments using Starlink and cellular measurement data show that SatCraft improves cumulative completed-service value by 3.61%-16.89% over baselines, including recent state-of-the-art scheduling methods ADPRL, EdgeOPT, and TF-DDRL. It achieves the highest completed-service value in all four resource profiles and averages 25.02 ms per scheduling call. These results demonstrate how LLM-guided policy optimization can improve complete service delivery under the computing, communication, and quality constraints of satellite-cellular networks.

papers.title_en: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
papers.authors: Meng Luo, Zechen Bai, Shanqing Xu, Yanlin Li, Kaixin Li, Mengchen Qian, Weifeng Lu, Ran Zhang, Yingtian Zou, Ziyang Luo, Wei Chen, Hongzhan Lin
papers.evidence: 机器人学习与物理智能中的递归自我改进
papers.tldr: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求系统既提升行为，也优化改进过程；数字智能体可通过改写代码与测试验证实现，但迁移到物理AI需面对部分观测、昂贵试错、工况变化与不可逆风险。本文在机器人学习中定位RSI，梳理从能力提升到改进过程提升的路径，并提出收益跨阶段传递的四项条件。现有操纵任务研究支持行为改进、学习增益与流程改进，但尚未隔离递归本身的贡献，作者据此给出评估原则与研究方向。
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.

papers.title_en: Adding Heavy-Ball Momentum to Distributed Constrained Optimization for Energy Resource Management Subject to Time-Delays and Quantization
papers.evidence: 面向能源资源管理的分布式约束优化
papers.tldr: 面向时延和量化影响下的分布式能源资源管理约束优化，本文研究一种带重球动量的离散时间符号梯度共识方法，并在每次迭代中严格保持总供需等式。该方法将固定对数量化误差分离为加性扰动，借助Lyapunov-Krasovskii泛函证明实用稳定性并给出可计算的不变子水平集。分析表明稳态遍历残差界与量化分辨率呈二次关系，无量化时可精确收敛到光滑罚函数等式约束最优解。针对无时延无量化二次代价，模态分析刻画重球稳定域和最优参数，延迟实验与发电机-电池混合实验验证了所提更新。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies a hybrid discrete-time signed gradient-consensus method with heavy-ball momentum, paired communication delays, and fixed logarithmic quantization. The method preserves the aggregate supply-demand equality at every iteration. For a static connected undirected graph and bounded delays, a Lyapunov-Krasovskii analysis establishes practical stability by isolating the discontinuous quantization error as an additive disturbance and closing a computable invariant-sublevel argument. The resulting ergodic residual bound is quadratic in the quantization resolution, and exact convergence to the smooth penalized equality-constrained optimizer is recovered in the unquantized case. For delay-free unquantized quadratic costs, an exact modal analysis identifies the heavy-ball stability region and optimal parameters, with the predicted rate validated on a fixed sparse network. A reproducible delayed experiment reports all constants and a certificate whose guaranteed steady-state level lies below the reported initialization. A separate mixed generator-battery experiment exercises the signed update directly. Finite smooth penalties approximate, but do not generally enforce, the local box constraints exactly.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies
papers.evidence: 强化学习引导机组组合调度与MILP
papers.tldr: 针对强化学习求解机组组合（UC）常比MILP更贵的问题，本文首次在EPRI 51机组72小时基准上诊断PPO/DQN的过度承诺，发现其源于独立决策采样下的探索噪声。通过模仿MILP解并保守微调，PPO将成本差距缩小至2.6%，且惩罚成本最低。固定其高置信决策可让MILP加速3.8-8.5倍、最优性损失仅0.10-0.25%。作者还揭示调度方法与基准范围对最优性报告的影响，并提出报告协议。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Bendpoint Formation in Octopus-Inspired Soft Continuum Arms
papers.authors: Jessica Gumowski, Julian Finn, Krishna Manaswi Digumarti, David Howard
papers.evidence: 受章鱼启发的软体连续臂利用具身智能实现灵巧弯曲
papers.tldr: 章鱼柔软手臂可在任意位置形成弯曲点，从而兼顾灵巧性与性能。研究将可充气壳体阵列嵌入腱驱动连续体手臂，充气使局部摩擦增大并锁住腱，形成临时锚点以自适应改变弯曲点。实验显示驱动段呈非恒定钟形曲率，接近真实章鱼伸展运动。相比传统单腱连续体 manipulator，该设计扩展工作空间并增强灵巧性，同时避免多段多驱动器的机械复杂度。
papers.abstract_en: Octopuses exhibit a powerful form of embodied intelligence from a highly adaptable soft body. One key mechanism is the ability to instantiate bending points at any location along the arm, which enables performant and dexterous behaviours. Taking inspiration from the octopus for its dexterity, this study focuses on changing the curvature of a tendon-actuated arm by adaptively changing the anchoring end-point along the arm. An array of inflatable shells is integrated into the arm, where inflating a shell causes an increase in friction at the location, jamming the tendon and creating a temporary new anchoring point. The novel soft actuator does not break the continuity of the arm between the actuated segment and the loose segment. Experiments show that the actuated segment has a non-constant bell-shaped curvature which is comparable to that of a real octopus arm during a reaching motion. Compared to conventional single-tendon continuum manipulators, the proposed design offers an expanded workspace and enhanced dexterity through the ability to independently shape different regions of the arm through selective curvature tuning. At the same time, it avoids the mechanical complexity typically associated with multi-segment, multi-actuator systems.

papers.title_en: Capacitated Line Aggregation with Maximum Delay
papers.evidence: 带延迟约束的容量线路聚合在线批处理算法
papers.tldr: 研究半直线上有容量约束且按批最大延迟计费的在线线路聚合：请求随时间到达，每批至多k个，成本含最远距离与最老等待。算法沿嵌套时间区间路径采用Next Fit思想，以路径负载检验决定并入已有批或开新批，并控制容量与开批成本。确定性竞争比为36+12√3，随机化共同尺度后期望竞争比为(18+6√3)/ln2，并可扩展到不可分尺寸；学习增强模型还给出(1+ε)一致性与O(ε^-2)鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: We study capacitated line aggregation with per-batch maximum delay. Requests arrive over time at locations on a rooted half-line and are served in instantaneous batches of at most $k$ requests. Each batch pays the distance to its farthest request plus the waiting time of its oldest request. The objective is to minimize the total cost.   We give a deterministic online algorithm with competitive ratio $36+12\sqrt3$. The algorithm uses a Next Fit idea along paths of nested time intervals: it assigns a new group to an existing batch when a path-load test permits, and opens a new batch otherwise. The path load controls both capacity and the cost of opening new batches. Randomizing the common scale improves the expected competitive ratio to $(18+6\sqrt3)/\ln2$ against an oblivious adversary. Both guarantees extend to arbitrary indivisible request sizes.   We also study capacitated LAD in the learning-augmented model. Advice revealed at its service times allows $(1+ε)$-consistency against every complete feasible advice schedule and $O(ε^{-2})$-robustness. The analysis charges repeated switches to successive decreases in the remaining advice cost.
